general.notes: 1550nm TX / 1310nm RX bidirectional wavelengths. Optical power launched into SMF (Note 1). Receiver sensitivity and overload measured with PRBS 2^23-1 @ 155Mbps, BER ≤1×10^-12 (Note 3). Operating case temperature variants: Standard 0 to +70°C (LS-BL553101-10C), Extended -20 to +80°C, Industrial -40 to +85°C (LS-BL553101-10I). Supply current Icc max 300 mA at 3.135–3.465 V; power in Watts not stated. Spectral Width (RMS) Δλ max 3 nm on transmitter. SMSR not specified in table (dashes). Diagnostic RX power range -32 to -6 dBm; TX -14 to -8 dBm.
general.suggestions: Distinguish TX vs RX wavelength fields in schema for WDM/bidirectional SFPs. Map Icc (mA) and Vcc to optional supply_power_mw if W is not printed.
